content.text: Ka mit ni lawkkamnae a sak,
Bang kecu dawk maw tangla hah ka mit ni a khet han.
Hatdawkvah, lathueng lae Cathut koehoi ka coe hane hoi,
Athakasaipounge koehoi a parâw e teh bangmaw.
Tamikathoutnaw raphoe teh,
payonpakainae ka sak e naw rawkphainae nahoehmaw.
Ama ni ka lamthung hah a hmu teh,
ka khokhnuk pueng hai be a touk nahoehmaw.
Kalan hoeh e lah ka hring pawiteh, hoeh pawiteh,
dumyennae hoi ka khok a hue rang pawiteh,
Kânging e yawcu khingnae hoi na khing haw,
Cathut ni ka lannae hah a panue thai han.
Ka pahni ni lamthung phen boipawiteh,
ka mit hoi ka hmu e patetlah lungthin ka tawn pawiteh,
ka kut dawk ka tamang e kâbet pawiteh,
Cati na tu sak haw, ayâ louk ni cat naseh,
ka a hane be phawng naseh.
Napui ni ka lungthin na pasawt payon pawiteh,
ka imri e takhang arulahoi ka tuet pawiteh,
ka yu ni ayâ hane cakang phawm naseh.
Ayâ ni ipkhai naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh kathoute lah awm vaiteh,
lawkcengnae koe tâcokhai hanelah
kamcu e payonnae lah ao han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, raphoe hanelah hmai ni a kak e lah ao han,
Ka tawn e abuemlah be kahmat e lah ao han.
Ka sannu sanpanaw ni kai koe a phuenang awh navah,
noutna laipalah kaawm pawiteh,
BAWIPA a thaw torei teh, kai ni bangmaw ka sak han.
Na toun navah bangtelamaw ka pato han.
Von thung vah kai ka sak e ni,
ahnimouh hai sak hoehnamaw,
ama ni manu e von thung rei na sak hoehnamaw.
Karoedengnaw, e a ngainae hah poe laipalah kaawm pawiteh,
lahmainaw lung ka pout sak pawiteh,
naranaw hah canei hane rei laipalah,
kama dueng ouk ka cat pawiteh,
Hateiteh, ahni hah ka nawca hoi a na pa patetlah ka okhai,
anu e von thung hoi lahmai patetlah ka khetyawt toe.
Tami bangpatet hai hnicu laipalah kadout e hoi,
tami karoedengnaw kâkhu han ka tawn hoeh e
ka hmawt boipawiteh,
A lungthin hoi kai yawhawi na poe hoeh teh,
ka tumuen hoi phu ka bet sak hoehpawiteh,
longkha koe e kabawpnae ka hmu torei teh,
naranaw taranlahoi ka kut ka dâw pawiteh,
ka kut heh ka loung dawk hoi kârakhing naseh,
ka lounghrunaw hah kâkhoe naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut koehoi rawkphainae teh,
kai hanelah taki a tho poung, bangkongtetpawiteh,
a lentoenae teh ka khang thai mahoeh.
Sui hah ngaihawinae hoi ka sak teh,
nang teh ka lungmawngnae doeh,
telah suikathoung koe ka dei boipawiteh,
ka kut hoi ka tawk e ni moikapap a hmu teh,
ka tawntanae a len poung dawkvah,
lunghawinae ka tawn boipawiteh,
kanî a sei torei ka pouk teh,
a angnae hoi ka cet e thapa hah a lawkpui lah ka pouk teh,
hottelah ka lungthin hah arulahoi a pasawt teh,
ka pahni ni ka kut pahnuem pawiteh,
het haiyah lawkcengnae hmuen koe
phakhai han kamcu e payonnae doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lathueng la kaawm e
Cathut hah pahnawt e lah ao.
Ka hmuhma e lathueng vah, rawkphainae a pha navah,
ka lunghawi teh, a lathueng vah kathout e ka hmu navah,
kai kâoup pawiteh,
Ka pahni ni yonnae dawk thoseh,
a hringnae hah thoebo hane kâpoe hanelah
ka pasoung hoeh e thoseh,
Lukkareiim dawk taminaw ni a teng vah kaawm e
apimaw von ka hlam e kaawm boi,
Hateiteh, imyin ni lam vah roe boi hoeh,
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kahlawng ka cet naw hanelah
ka im vah tho ouk ka paawng pouh.
Adam patetlah kâtapoenae hah ka ramuk teh,
ka payonpakainae hah ka lungtabue thung ka hrawk pawiteh,
Tamimaya a pap poung dawkvah, ka taki teh
ka imthungnaw dudamnae ka taki kecu dawkvah,
duem ka o e hoi alawilah tâco thai hoeh e lah kaawm pawiteh,
Oe, kapanuekkhaikung buet tabang awm haw pawiteh,
khenhaw! hetteh kaie kutnout doeh, Athakasaipounge ni,
na pato haw pawiteh, kai na katarannaw ni
cauk dawk thut haw pawiteh,
Ka loung dawk hoi roeroe ka sin vaiteh,
bawilukhung patetlah ka kâmuk han ei .
Ka khokhnuknaw pueng hai ama koe ka pâpho han,
bawi patetlah ama teh ka hnai han ei.
Ka ram ni kai taranlahoi a hram teh,
laikawk kongnaw ni cungtalah khui awh pawiteh,
aphu poe laipalah a pawnaw hah ka ca teh,
katawnkungnaw hringnae sung sak e lah kaawm boipawiteh,
hottelah cang yueng lah pâkhing paw naseh,
Catun yueng lah phovainaw paw naseh telah a ti,
Job e lawk a pâpout toe.
